ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; no driver fault recorded, no account flag.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's written claim that he waited more than 3 minutes is contradicted by the timeline/GPS: the "I'm Here" tap at 13:02:45 to cancellation at 13:05:40 gives only 2 min 55 s within 200 m [F6][F4]; system records override statements.
In-chat assertion "Waited more than 3 min" is not supported by the timestamps; the 3-minute threshold was not met at the moment of cancellation.
